redistribution_classes.meaning: AGID-created metadata and non-production fixtures only.
Public official pages and lookup behavior retained only as audit receipts; access does not grant bulk extraction, transformation, database redistribution or public serving.
An exact official distribution under explicit open reuse terms with attribution, edition, date, schema, CRS, coverage and digest pinned; its authority remains limited to its declared subject.
Licensed, purchased, permissioned, credentialed or otherwise controlled material used only as specifically permitted.
Personal, customer, shipment, credential, ownership and private property evidence is excluded from public artifacts.

sources.production_scope: The public pages establish the NNNN-NNN format, postal designation and address-driven lookup behavior. They are audit receipts, not a current complete assignment/exception distribution, reuse grant or geometry authority.

CTT describes database licensing, portions of its address database, minimum use periods and geographic webservices. Door coordinates in WGS84 EPSG:4326 are address points, not postcode polygons. No controlled source may be used beyond a separately reviewed agreement.

DGT states that CTT assigns postcodes and that DGT does not create or otherwise intervene in postcode codes. DGT open administrative, land-use, cadastral and imagery collections retain their own authority and cannot substitute for postal areas.

artifact_partitions.rule: Current CTT assignment, postal designation, exception/non-area semantics, edition, date, terms and digest remain operator evidence separate from geometry.
Only exact authoritative postcode Polygon/MultiPolygon features can be served as areas; P.O.-box, organization, route, point, membership-only and missing features remain explicit non-areas.
DGT/CAOP, parish, municipality, cadastral, street, address and door-point geometry retain their own authority and never become postal area by relabelling, union, buffer or nearest match.
Minimal non-personal lookup receipts may test expected public behavior but never become a bulk distribution or production artifact.
Licensed databases, credentials, customers, recipients, occupants, owners, shipments and private property records never enter the open country seed.
Non-production fixture metadata only; never promotion evidence.
